description: Implementation of TCP socket operations for POSIX systems, including socket options, connection handling, and performance monitoring.

classes.name: TCPSocketPosix
classes.description: POSIX implementation of TCP socket with connection, read/write, and socket options management.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a socket with the specified address family.

methods.name: BindToNetwork
methods.description: Binds the socket to a specific network handle (Android).

methods.name: AdoptConnectedSocket
methods.description: Adopts an existing connected socket descriptor.

methods.name: AdoptUnconnectedSocket
methods.description: Adopts an existing unconnected socket descriptor.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a local address.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Marks the socket as a passive socket that will accept incoming connections.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initiates a connection to a remote address.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket.

methods.name: ReadIfReady
methods.description: Reads data if the socket is ready.

methods.name: CancelReadIfReady
methods.description: Cancels a read if ready operation.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the remote peer address.

methods.name: SetDefaultOptionsForServer
methods.description: Sets default socket options for server mode.

methods.name: SetDefaultOptionsForClient
methods.description: Sets default socket options for client mode.

methods.name: AllowAddressReuse
methods.description: Enables address reuse option.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size.

methods.name: SetKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables or disables TCP keep-alive with delay.

methods.name: SetNoDelay
methods.description: Enables or disables Nagle's algorithm (TCP_NODELAY).

methods.name: SetIPv6Only
methods.description: Sets IPv6 only mode.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the socket is valid.

methods.name: DetachFromThread
methods.description: Detaches socket from thread context.

methods.name: StartLoggingMultipleConnectAttempts
methods.description: Begins logging multiple connect attempts.

methods.name: EndLoggingMultipleConnectAttempts
methods.description: Ends logging multiple connect attempts.

methods.name: ReleaseSocketDescriptorForTesting
methods.description: Releases the socket descriptor for testing purposes.

methods.name: SocketDescriptorForTesting
methods.description: Returns the socket descriptor for testing.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag.

methods.name: AcceptCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of accept operation.

methods.name: HandleAcceptCompleted
methods.description: Processes accept completion result.

methods.name: BuildTcpSocketPosix
methods.description: Builds a TCP socket object after accept.

methods.name: ConnectCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of connect operation.

methods.name: HandleConnectCompleted
methods.description: Processes connect completion result.

methods.name: LogConnectBegin
methods.description: Logs the beginning of a connect attempt.

methods.name: LogConnectEnd
methods.description: Logs the end of a connect attempt.

methods.name: ReadCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation.

methods.name: ReadIfReadyCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a read-if-ready operation.

methods.name: HandleReadCompleted
methods.description: Processes read completion.

methods.name: HandleReadCompletedHelper
methods.description: Helper for processing read completion.

methods.name: WriteCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a write operation.

methods.name: HandleWriteCompleted
methods.description: Processes write completion.

methods.name: NotifySocketPerformanceWatcher
methods.description: Notifies performance watcher of RTT updates.

methods.name: GetEstimatedRoundTripTime
methods.description: Retrieves estimated RTT.
